name: Carbon Based Menu Side Cart
author: carbonbasedstudio

sections.description:
Carbon Based Menu Side Cart adds a cart icon to the menus you choose. Click it to open a slide-out mini cart. The icon and cart update as customers add products.

Features

  • Menu cart toggle – Inject a cart icon into selected classic wp_nav_menu() locations, with insert position per menu (start, after Nth item, end, or end pinned to the far right).
  • Off-canvas mini cart – Slide-in panel with product rows, quantity, prices, subtotal, View cart / Checkout, and a configurable footer button.
  • Appearance – Icon, panel, header, subtotal/buttons, footer, and remove-button colours and typography; optional header and footer background images; custom CSS.
  • Behaviour – Optional open on WooCommerce catalog AJAX add to cart, slide duration, admin-bar offset, hide badge or subtotal when empty, aria-label, and add-to-cart lock/restore.
  • Shortcode – Place the toggle anywhere with [cbsmsc_side_cart].
  • Information tab – Closed topics matching each settings tab, plus deactivate and uninstall help.

Requires WooCommerce. Settings are under Carbon Based > Menu Side Cart.

Who is this for?

  • WooCommerce stores that want a cart icon in a classic menu.
  • Shops that want a slide-out mini cart instead of sending the customer straight to the cart page.

User guide

Setup and menu placement are covered in the Menu Side Cart user guide.

sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the carbon-based-menu-side-cart folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the zip via Plugins > Add New.
  3. Activate Carbon Based Menu Side Cart.
  4. Open Carbon Based > Menu Side Cart, enable at least one menu location, and save.
